{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "PROJECT BRIEF — Build a bold static React website for a real-estate portfolio / documentation site called “Aster Lane Realty Portfolio”. Need a clean but strong landing + docs style website, fully static, no backend, no login, no database, no APIs, no live maps, no real listings feed. Use mock/sample content only.

Goal: create a professional portfolio website for an independent real estate advisor that presents property case studies, buying/selling guides, neighborhood notes, and a contact inquiry form. It should feel like a mix of modern real-estate branding + Twitter/X style feed cards: short updates, testimonial quote cards, property insight posts, clean dividers, bold typography, lots of white/charcoal space, accent blue.

TECH: React single page static site. Can use Vite or plain React. CSS modules / Tailwind / regular CSS is fine. Must run as a static front-end only.

STYLE DIRECTION:
- Bold editorial layout
- Real estate portfolio, not a marketplace
- Reference vibe: Twitter/X profile/feed layout but more premium and polished
- Color palette: deep charcoal #111827, off white #F8FAFC, Twitter-like blue #1DA1F2, warm sand #E9DCC9, muted green #7A8F7A
- Large strong headings, simple cards, rounded corners, subtle borders
- No complicated animations, just light hover states
- Mobile responsive
- Simple complexity, no unnecessary features

MAIN STRUCTURE:
1. Sticky top nav
   Logo text: Aster Lane Realty
   Menu: Overview, Portfolio, Guides, Market Notes, Contact
   CTA button: Start Inquiry

2. HERO SECTION
   Left side:
   Small label: Independent Real Estate Portfolio
   Big headline: “Documented property strategy for buyers, sellers, and investors.”
   Paragraph: explain that the advisor helps clients understand neighborhoods, pricing, staging, negotiation, and long-term property decisions.
   Buttons: “View Portfolio” and “Read Buyer Guide”
   Trust row: 42 sample closings documented, 18 neighborhood briefs, 9 seller playbooks, 100% static demo content
   Right side:
   Create a Twitter-inspired profile card:
   - Header banner gradient
   - Avatar initials “AL”
   - Name: Aster Lane Realty
   - Handle: @asterlanehomes
   - Bio: Real estate advisory notes, case studies, and practical property documentation.
   - Stats: 42 Case Studies, 18 Areas, 120 Notes
   - A pinned post card: “Pinned: How we prepare a listing before it hits the market.”

3. PORTFOLIO CASE STUDIES SECTION
   Title: Property Portfolio Documentation
   Subtitle: static examples of documented client scenarios
   Add 6 property cards, NOT real listings, just sample portfolio cases:
   - Riverside Townhouse Preparation — Seller strategy, staging checklist, offer review
   - North Park First-Time Buyer Plan — Budget map, inspection notes, timeline
   - Westline Condo Refresh — Pricing reposition, photography checklist, open house copy
   - Oak Meadow Family Move — School-zone comparison, contingency planning
   - Downtown Loft Investment Review — rental assumptions, risk notes, exit strategy
   - Garden District Downsizing Plan — decluttering, valuation notes, move calendar
   Each card should include: category tag, short summary, 3 bullet points, mock price range or outcome label, and a “Read case note” button that just anchors or is visual only.

4. DOCUMENTATION / GUIDE SECTION
   This is important because I want it to feel like a documentation site, not just a generic homepage.
   Use a two-column layout:
   Left sidebar titled “Guides” with links:
   - Buyer Readiness
   - Seller Prep
   - Offer Review
   - Inspection Notes
   - Neighborhood Research
   - Moving Timeline
   Right content panel with documentation-style content:
   Heading: Buyer Readiness Checklist
   Include code-doc-like blocks but for real estate, for example:
   Step 01 — Define budget range
   Step 02 — List must-have property criteria
   Step 03 — Compare neighborhoods
   Step 04 — Prepare offer documents
   Step 05 — Review inspection findings
   Add callout boxes: “Advisor Note”, “Common Mistake”, “Static Sample”.

5. MARKET NOTES SECTION
   Make it like a Twitter feed but static.
   Title: Market Notes Feed
   Include 5 short post cards with avatar initials, handle @asterlanehomes, date labels like Jun 2026, and fake static insights. No real-time data.
   Example topics:
   - Why presentation quality can change buyer perception
   - How to compare two similar homes
   - What makes a strong offer besides price
   - Reading inspection reports without panic
   - Neighborhood walks before final decisions
   Each post card has small icons as plain text like Reply, Share, Save, but they do nothing.

6. SERVICES / PROCESS SECTION
   Title: Simple Advisory Process
   4 steps:
   1 Discovery Call — goals, timeline, constraints
   2 Property Documentation — notes, checklists, comparisons
   3 Strategy Review — offer/seller plan and risk review
   4 Decision Support — final checklist and next steps
   Make it visual with big numbers.

7. TESTIMONIALS SECTION
   Twitter/X style testimonial cards, static only:
   - “The prep checklist made our sale feel organized instead of stressful.” — Sample Seller
   - “The neighborhood comparison notes helped us choose with confidence.” — Sample Buyer
   - “Clear documentation, simple language, no pressure.” — Sample Investor

8. CONTACT / INQUIRY FORM
   Static form only, no submission backend. If submit button exists it can show visual only or be plain HTML. Fields:
   - Full Name
   - Email
   - I am interested in: Buying / Selling / Investing / General Guidance
   - Preferred neighborhood
   - Message
   Button: Send Static Inquiry
   Add small note: “Demo form only — no data is sent.”

9. FOOTER
   Logo and short description
   Links: Overview, Portfolio, Guides, Notes, Contact
   Disclaimer: This is a static portfolio demo with sample content, not live listings or financial advice.

DESIGN DETAILS:
- Use cards with border #E5E7EB and soft shadows
- Button styles: primary blue fill, secondary outline
- Typography should be bold, modern, readable
- Add subtle section labels in uppercase
- Use responsive grid: desktop two/three columns, mobile one column
- No external image dependencies required; use gradients, initials, simple icons/emojis if needed
- All content can be hardcoded in React arrays
- Avoid backend, auth, search API, real estate API, map API, payments, booking system, admin dashboard, CMS, database

DELIVERABLE: a polished static React website with clear component structure and sample content. Make it look complete and professional even though it is simple.",

  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
